name: deputy
description: Your proxy for judgement questions: answers from your own recorded decisions and pinned assertions in a separate memory-ledger root, cites every entry it uses, and escalates what it cannot settle. Needs memory-ledger@bootgear. Install via `codex plugin add deputy@bootgear`.

interface.shortDescription: Answer judgement questions from your recorded decisions, or escalate.
interface.longDescription: Deputy answers a judgement question the way you would, from your recorded decisions and pinned assertions, cites every entry it uses, and escalates what it cannot settle. Its hooks remind the session to ask the deputy before it asks you, and to record your answer to an escalated question.
